variants.label: A
variants.note: Fine pleats: about twenty slim vertical folds, evenly hung, with a restrained sway at their lower ends.

variants.label: B
variants.note: Broad drapes: about eight rounded, satin-like folds with stronger shading and a slow weighted sway.

variants.label: C
variants.note: Gathered silk: irregularly spaced folds, fine creases on rounded faces, and more billowing toward the bottom.
